item.title: Trump says U.S. and Canada reached deal to delay 50% U.S. tariffs on Canadian imports
item.description: President Trump said he was delaying the 50% U.S. tariffs on Canadian imports after the two countries reached a last-minute deal less than two hours before the sanctions were to go into effect.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Trump administration moves to open untouched national forests to logging
item.description: The end of "roadless rule" protections would open millions of acres of pristine forests to commercial use. Supporters say it will lead to better managed forests.
item.content:encoded:

item.title: Embattled Florida Republican Rep. Cory Mills loses his fight to keep his House seat
item.description: Mills is the latest lawmaker in a recent string of congressional members facing scandals and allegations of domestic abuse while trying to run for elected office.

item.title: ABC and Disney sue FCC, alleging First Amendment violations
item.description: The ABC network has sued the Federal Communications Commission, alleging that the Trump administration is violating its First Amendment rights by challenging ABC broadcast licenses and investigating the network's talk show The View.

item.title: 'Shrinking' star Jason Segel isn't afraid to share the 'dirty underneath'
item.description: "If I have a superpower that I can't take credit for ... [it's] that I'm very vulnerable," Segel says. He plays a widowed therapist who offers very blunt advice in the Apple TV series Shrinking.

item.title: 'Profits won.' The child safety trial against Meta kicks off in federal court
item.description: Opening arguments are underway in a trial that pits four states against the company that owns Facebook and Instagram. They allege that Meta knew its products could hook kids — and lied about the danger.

item.description: AI can generate songs in seconds. But behind every AI track is a complicated question: Who should get paid? And, how? The fights have started.

item.title: In Portland, this soap box derby combines downhill speed with extreme pageantry
item.description: Soap box derbies send motorless cars down a steep incline. At one event, contestants make their cars look like cartoon characters, subway cars, food, and giant animals (among other outlandish shapes).
